findings.issue: The docstring of `invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff'` calls `Q² ≤ 2 P·q` "the raw form of the threshold `W² ≥ M²` … needing no symmetry of the bilinear form". That identification does require symmetry: for general `g`, `W² = p·p + p·q + q·p + q·q`, so `W² ≥ M²` is `p·q + q·p ≥ Q²`, not `2 p·q ≥ Q²`.

summary: Both new files carry module docstrings and the definitions are documented, but one docstring narrates its proof and two docstrings misdescribe the symmetry hypothesis under which the raw inequalities equal W² ≥ M².
